Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
Here is the man....

Name: Jack Dawson
Rarity: U1

Cardtype: Vampire

Clan: Samedi

Capacity: 8

Discipline: cel nec qui thn FOR OBF

Independent: When you move Jack from your uncontrolled region to your ready
region, you may equip him with a weapon card from your hand (pay the cost to
equip as normal).

**

Can you equip Jack with any weapon, even if he doesn't meet the requirement,
since it's not an equip action ? (eg : give a femur to jack ;) )

reyda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Sten During wrote:
> Followup question, also concerning Pier 13.
>
> Is the equipment card played? By played I mean as in can be stopped by
> Direct Intervention.

Online rulings: "[DI] Can only burn minion cards played from the
hand in the normal fashion (not weapons played via Disguised Weapon
or equipment played via Pier 13, for example). [RTR 20001020]"

> As a sidequestion I assume that Rewind Time is moot anyway as an
> equipment card is not an action card. Correct?

Yes. Although the Jyhad rulebook identified them as action cards.
That changed in the 1995 V:TES rulebook. It may change back in the
Camarilla edition; I'll have the DT look into it.
